description: Builds Angular forms from JSON Schema. @ajsf/core renders plain HTML widgets, @ajsf/material and @ajsf/primeng supply their own, and the Bootstrap 3, 4 and 5 packages restyle the core widgets, with Bootstrap 4 and 5 adding their own checkbox, checkboxes and radios widgets.
rules: The @ajsf/* major equals the Angular major it targets, for example @ajsf/material@17 for Angular 17. Peer ranges are bounded, so a mismatched major fails to install.

Install at least one framework package: @ajsf/material, @ajsf/primeng, @ajsf/bootstrap3, @ajsf/bootstrap4 or @ajsf/bootstrap5. Each depends on @ajsf/core. Several can be installed and switched at runtime. Use @ajsf/core alone only for unstyled HTML.
Keep every @ajsf/* package in a project on the same version. The six packages are released together.

Import the framework module in the imports of the standalone component that renders the form, or of the NgModule that declares it: MaterialDesignFrameworkModule, PrimengFrameworkModule, Bootstrap3FrameworkModule, Bootstrap4FrameworkModule or Bootstrap5FrameworkModule. Nothing goes in app.config.ts for them.
JsonSchemaFormModule from @ajsf/core renders plain HTML. A standalone component that imports only it also needs providers: [FrameworkLibraryService] from @ajsf/core, or the form fails with NG0201.
No animations provider and no @angular/animations package are needed, and zoneless change detection works. @ajsf/primeng does not need @angular/animations either.
@ajsf/material and @ajsf/primeng take a new app's initial bundle to 1.40 MB and 1.55 MB, above the 1 MB maximumError budget ng new writes, so raise the initial budget in angular.json.

Render with <json-schema-form [schema]="schema" framework="material-design" (onSubmit)="onSubmit($event)">. framework accepts material-design, primeng, bootstrap-3, bootstrap-4, bootstrap-5 and no-framework, the default.
@ajsf/material needs @angular/material and @angular/cdk at the same major, and a Material theme in the app.
@ajsf/primeng needs primeng at the same major. The app sets the theme with providePrimeNG and a preset from @primeuix/themes.

[loadExternalAssets]="true" loads framework CSS and scripts from a CDN and is for trying the library out. Bind it with brackets: the input is a boolean and the plain attribute fails with TS2322 in a project created by ng new. In production, load those assets in the app and remove it. For Material it loads fonts, not a theme.
Two-way binding works with [(data)], [(ngModel)], [(model)] and [(formData)], not with the combined [form] input.
Add or replace widgets with the widgets input or WidgetLibraryService.registerWidget(type, component). Switch or supply a framework with the framework input or FrameworkLibraryService.setFramework.
Form wide validation messages go in options.defautWidgetOptions.validationMessages. That spelling is public API: do not correct it to defaultWidgetOptions.
A schema without $schema is read as draft 7 unless the defaultDraft input names another draft. JSON Schema 2019-09 and 2020-12 are not supported, and a 2020-12 $schema fails to compile.
Draft 7 if, then and else are validated, but the layout is built once and does not react to them.
contains and dependencies are enforced on the whole form: isValid is false, validationErrors reports them and the submit button stays disabled, but no field shows a message for them.
The language input sets the validation message language: de, en, es, fr, it, pt or zh.
